candidates.label: Yalvaç (ancient Antioch in Pisidia)
candidates.support: The visible ruins near modern Yalvaç, precisely surveyed and excavated, are the undisputed site of Antioch in Pisidia; Pleiades and Wikidata's coordinates agree to within a few meters.

summary.text: Antioch in Pisidia (kept distinct here from Antioch on the Orontes in Syria) is also recorded under the additional name 'Col. Caesarea' (Colonia Caesarea), reflecting Roman colonial status. In Acts 13, Paul and Barnabas preached in its synagogue on the Sabbath, and after opposition from the city's Jews, Paul declared, 'we turn to the Gentiles.'

history.text: Although Acts calls it 'Antioch of Pisidia,' the International Standard Bible Encyclopedia explains that the city lay in Galatian Phrygia, near Pisidia's northern border, and took the name from its closeness to Pisidia and its role as the base of the Roman military system that pacified the Pisidian highlands. Phrygia was then divided between the provinces of Asia and Galatia, and Antioch lay in the Galatian part, so this project gives the province of Galatia as its parent.

scripture.textWEB: But they, passing on from Perga, came to Antioch of Pisidia. They went into the synagogue on the Sabbath day and sat down.
But some Jews from Antioch and Iconium came there, and having persuaded the multitudes, they stoned Paul and dragged him out of the city, supposing that he was dead.
When they had preached the Good News to that city and had made many disciples, they returned to Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch,
persecutions, and sufferings—those things that happened to me at Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. I endured those persecutions. The Lord delivered me out of them all.

politicalHistory.note: Includes Pisidia, Lycaonia (the western part) and Paphlagonia, which had already joined the province of Galatia (Pisidia and Lycaonia in 25 BC on King Amyntas's death; Paphlagonia in 6 BC) before this note's window begins. Vespasian detached most of Pisidia to the new province of Lycia and Pamphylia in AD 74; no source describing exactly where that internal line ran was found, so this area is kept whole rather than guessing at a split.
